name: Speed Champions
desc:
⚡Welcome to Speed Champions⚡

HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Increase your speed by gaining steps and levelling up.
💥 Use your speed to destroy your opponents in races.
💰 Sell your steps for coins and upgrade boots. energies and classes in the shop!
💎Complete courses and win races to earn gems to buy pets and trails!
♻️ Buy All Classes to Rebirth Once! Unlock new rebirths for free Pet Equip and Storage! Rebirthing also Unlocks Rebirth Worlds!
📈 Try to get to the top of the leaderboards and become the best simulator player on Roblox!

⚡Group Members receive FREE Auto Hatch!

scripts.title: *OP* SCRIPT
scripts.script:
_G.autoEggHunt = true

while _G.autoEggHunt do
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Easter Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "St Patrick Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Frost Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Golem Egg")

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Inferno Egg")

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Claim")
end
